findings.evidence: Lines 281–288 construct `PSL(2, ℤ) →* Equiv.Perm (TraceFormulaMatrixModule n)`, while line 292 uses it to define the public action operation.
findings.fix: Expose and namespace this homomorphism as part of the `TraceFormulaMatrixModule` API, with an application lemma relating it to `rightPSL`.
findings.issue: `traceFormulaMatrixRightPSLHom` is private, hiding the canonical packaged PSL permutation action that downstream extension to `ℚ[ℳₙ]` needs.

findings.evidence: The unannotated declarations occur at lines 308, 336, and 364, whereas the parallel SL right-action law at line 229 already has `@[simp]`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to all three product laws; each strictly rewrites an action by a product into successive actions.
findings.issue: The product laws `rightPSL_mul_rev`, `conj_mul`, and `conjPSL_mul` are characteristic action normalizations but are not tagged `@[simp]`, unlike `right_mul_rev`.

summary: The right-action package needed for the subsequent group-ring construction is hidden, and several action laws lack normal-form automation.
